stepTitle: A $$100\, \text{g}$$ toy car is propelled by a compressed spring that starts it moving. Find the final speed of the car if its initial speed is $$2.00\,\text{m/s}$$ and it coasts up the frictionless slope, gaining $$0.180\, \text{m}$$ in altitude. Give the speed to three significant figures (in $$\text{m/s})$$.
